subject: Post-call: workload profile & pricing target
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: workload profile & pricing target

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the 45-minute call today. Quick recap from our side and a small set of asks so we can put a scoped pricing proposal on paper.

What we heard (please flag anything missing):
- Primary use: in-product assistant (search + multi-turn guidance) and batch reranking for recommendations.
- Avg users: ~12k monthly active users; peak concurrency expectation ~120 per minute.
- Typical prompt length: 300 tokens (user prompt + system instructions on average).
- Typical completion length: 1,100 tokens (richer assistant responses for detailed guidance).
- Context requirements: 85% of interactions fit within 8k context; 12% require 32k; 3% expected to need 128k (long document summarization / legal).
- Estimated monthly consumption (high-level, as stated): 150M prompt tokens + 550M completion tokens = ~700M tokens/month.
- Initial budget range indicated by Liam on the call: $8k–$25k/month while piloting; expansion expected if unit economics justify.

Key asks / next steps from us to you:
1) Share a 3-day sample of raw prompt+response pairs (anonymized) or the small JSON sample you mentioned — we can run a quick token mix and context-length histogram.
2) Confirm whether the 3% of 128k usage is expected to be synchronous (low latency) or batch/offline.
3) Procurement contact for draft SOW / early PO (you mentioned procure@acme.com).

What we’ll deliver (by Tue EOD PT):
- A short cost model showing unit economics with target $/1M tokens across the observed mix (breakouts for 8k/32k/128k).
- Two pricing options: pilot (committed monthly) and pilot+burst (committed + capped on-demand volume).

Attachments: I’m attaching a lightweight pricing workbook (redwood-pricing-model.xlsx) and a small sample schema for the context export we use (acme_sample_contexts.json). Please attach your sample when convenient.

If that all looks right, can we lock a follow-up on Tue 11/11 at 10am PT to review the cost sheet live with Liam and procurement?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Green <samantha@acme.com>

Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>, procure@acme.com
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 18:03:42 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: workload profile & pricing target

Thanks Karthik — this is perfect and captures the ask. A couple clarifications and I’m attaching the three-day anonymized sample you requested.

Clarifications:
- The 128k use (3%) is almost entirely batch summarization and will be processed overnight; not latency-sensitive. Only a handful of legal-team flows will be synchronous but that’s <0.1% of traffic.
- On prompt tokens: the 300-token avg includes system instructions; front-end truncation sometimes splits large documents before we send.
- For the pilot we’re aiming for a predictable cap of $20k/month (Liam’s comfort zone) with a 3-month pilot and an expectation to expand within 90 days if the quality and latency meet SLOs.

Attached: acme_sample_contexts.json (anonymized) — small file with 2,200 sample interactions; note the distribution field in the file showing context lengths.

We can do Tue 11/11 10am PT. Procurement looped in for the SOW draft.

—Sam
Samantha Green
Head of Product, Acme Corp
samantha@acme.com

Attachments:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 07:15:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: preliminary priced options for ACME pilot (for 11/11 review)

Karthik / Jordan — I ran the sample Sam sent through our tokenizer and produced a short breakdown. High-level findings:
- Raw sample size: 2,200 interactions; token histogram matches the stated mix: median prompt 290; median completion 1,050.
- Context length buckets (sample-weighted): 79% <=8k, 16% 8k-32k, 5% 32k-128k. Note: Sam’s production estimate of 3% 128k looks conservative relative to the sample (sample shows 5% >32k).
- Monthlyized extrapolation (using their stated MAU and sample rates): ~180M prompt tokens, ~650M completion tokens -> ~830M tokens/mo.

Pricing options (two quick sketches):
A) Pilot Committed — $18,500/mo for 3 months (committed 1.0B tokens/month cap). Unit economics effective: ~$18.5 / 1M tokens across the observed mix. Includes 95th pctl latency SLA for 8k flows; batch 128k jobs run on reserved nightly capacity (no extra infra charge).
B) Pilot Committed + Burst — $12,000/mo committed (500M tokens) + on-demand tier with $22 / 1M tokens above commit, capped at $40k/mo. Lower entry price but higher marginal above commit.

Notes:
- We should emphasize the separate cost profile for 8k vs 32/128k — for proposals I’d show a blended $/1M plus a table showing per-bucket cost impact.
- Suggest we propose a short 30% pilot credit applied to the first invoice so the net first-month spend sits inside their $20k target.

Actions for 11/11 call:
- Karthik: bring the per-bucket cost table (8k/32k/128k) and the latency SLO language for pilot.
- Jordan: draft the 3-month SOW with pilot terms + early-exit clause.

I’ll prepare a short slide with the two options and a recommended default (Option A) to present.

-M
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@acme.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>, procure@acme.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: workload profile & pricing target

Sam / Liam / procurement team — thanks for the sample and for confirming the pilot budget target. Based on the sample and Marissa’s modeled options, here’s a succinct recommendation so procurement has something concrete to review ahead of Tue: 

Recommended commercial (quick):
- Option: Pilot Committed (Option A)
- Term: 3 months, start on receipt of PO
- Committed monthly: 1.0B tokens at $18,500/month (applies to prompt + completion combined)
- Pilot credit: 30% first-month credit applied to invoice (net first invoice ≈ $12,950)
- Overages: Additional tokens billed at $22 / 1M tokens up to a hard cap of $38k/month to protect budget
- 128k batch jobs: executed on reserved overnight capacity at no separate infra charge; synchronous 128k calls routed to on-demand with fallbacks to 32k if concurrency spikes

Deliverables and ops:
- We’ll share a short 1-page appendix showing per-bucket unit economics (8k / 32k / 128k) and the expected blended $/1M.
- Technical onboarding checklist + access instructions will be sent once PO is in (Jordan will handle SOW).

If that aligns, Jordan / procure — can we expect a draft PO or SOW by EOD Wed 11/12? Otherwise we can reconvene after Tue’s call. I’ll bring the appendix to the 11/11 call at 10am PT.

Best — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
